name: Copy.ai
description_en:
Copy.ai currently positions itself as a go-to-market AI platform for marketing, sales and operations. Chat and content drafting are part of a broader workflow system that can research accounts, process leads, enrich records and assemble localized content. Actions are workflow building blocks, while Tables and brand context support shared information.

A Chat subscription and a workflow automation package have different capacity models. Unlimited chat words do not establish unlimited research, API calls or workflow execution. Evaluate the precise data and actions needed rather than treating the product as only an unlimited-copy generator.
description_zh:
Copy.ai 目前定位为营销、销售及运营的 GTM AI 平台，聊天和起草只是部分，工作流还可研究账户、处理线索、补充记录及组织本地化内容。Actions 是流程构件，Tables 和品牌上下文支持共享信息。

Chat 与流程自动化套餐采用不同容量，不限聊天字数不代表研究、API 或流程无限。应核对需要的数据与动作，不把它仅视为无限文案生成器。

core_features.explanation_en: Combine research, generation and integrations as configured actions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把研究、生成和集成组合成配置动作。

core_features.explanation_en: Use chat projects and brand information for assisted drafting.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用聊天项目及品牌信息辅助起草。

en: Create a source-checked account brief before an authorized CRM handoff.
zh: 生成经过来源核对的账户简报，再作获授权 CRM 交接。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Map input, research, generation and destination actions, then test a small run and inspect Credits used.
steps.zh: 映射输入、研究、生成及目标动作，先小范围运行并检查额度。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

pricing.billing_basis: Chat seats versus workflow-credit/seat packages and custom Enterprise implementation.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Chat five seats: $29/month or $288/year ($24 monthly equivalent). Growth $12,000/year: seventy-five seats/20,000 workflow credits monthly; Expansion $24,000/year: 150/45,000; Scale $36,000/year: 200/75,000. Enterprise quoted. Credit use varies by run; currency, overage/rollover and external costs require confirmation.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Chat 5 席月 $29 或年 $288（月折合 $24）；Growth 年 $12,000、75 席/月 20,000 额度，Expansion 年 $24,000、150/月 45,000，Scale 年 $36,000、200/月 75,000。Enterprise 询价，每次消耗不同，币种、超额/结转及外部费需确认。

sources.title: Future proof your business with GTM AI
sources.research_notes_en: Current GTM platform with Workflows, Actions, Tables, Agents and brand context; writing is one use case.

sources.title: Plans & Pricing | Copy.ai
sources.research_notes_en: Chat seat-based versus workflow-credit packages; credit use depends on steps/content and actual per-run panel; annual amounts and change conditions.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Separate research input, generated copy and the CRM write
sections.title_zh: 区分研究输入、生成文案与 CRM 写入
sections.en: For an illustrative account brief, provide a company identifier, collect permitted source information, generate a draft and review it before any CRM update or outreach. Each is a different action with its own permissions and failure effects. A successful generated paragraph does not prove the research is correct or the destination record was updated. No external message or workflow was executed.
sections.zh: 例如账户简报，可提供公司标识、收集允许来源、生成初稿并审核，再考虑 CRM 更新或联系。每步动作的权限和失败影响不同，生成段落成功不证明研究正确或目标记录已更新。本文未执行对外消息或工作流。

sections.title_en: Workflow credit use is not one credit per run
sections.title_zh: 流程额度不等于每次运行一个
sections.en: The FAQ says credits represent computation and vary with workflow steps and generated content; inspect the run’s Credits used panel. Chat lists five seats at $29 monthly or $24/month billed $288 yearly. Growth lists seventy-five seats and 20,000 workflow credits/month at $12,000 yearly; Expansion and Scale increase seats and credits at $24,000/$36,000 yearly. These annual equivalents are not month-to-month offers.
sections.zh: FAQ 称额度代表计算，随步骤及生成内容变化，应查看运行的 Credits used。Chat 5 席月 $29，或年 $288、折合月 $24。Growth 75 席、月 20,000 流程额度，年 $12,000；Expansion、Scale 提高人数和额度，年 $24,000/$36,000。年度折合价不是逐月购买报价。

sections.title_en: Check the enterprise and connector requirements
sections.en: Enterprise advertises API/bulk workflow runs, integrations and guided implementation under a custom scope. The pricing FAQ permits adding credits and describes self-serve plan-change adjustments, but exact rollover, failed-run charges and external-provider costs were not established. A connector label does not prove every CRM object or operation exists. Confirm one representative run’s usage and write permissions before scaling.
sections.zh: Enterprise 以定制范围提供 API/批量运行、集成和实施。FAQ 允许加额度，并介绍自助套餐变更调整，但未确定结转、失败运行计费或外部提供商费用。连接名称不证明所有 CRM 对象或动作存在，扩大前需核对代表性运行用量和写权限。

sections.title_en: Evaluate the output and operational ownership
sections.en: Copy.ai merits investigation for repeatable GTM research/content handoffs with an owner for errors. A personal editor may only need Chat or another narrower tool. Review names, claims, citations, localization and brand voice; an AI translation is not verified native-language quality. Vendor savings and pipeline claims were not independently measured. No source license, self-hosting or data-retention contract was verified.
sections.zh: 重复 GTM 研究/内容交接且有人处理错误时可研究 Copy.ai，个人编辑可能只需 Chat 或更窄工具。应核对姓名、主张、引用、本地化和品牌，AI 翻译不等于已验证母语质量。节省与销售管道宣传未独立测量，源码许可、自托管及保留合同未核实。

research_gaps: No chat, workflow, research, CRM write, localization, API or credit consumption was tested.
Credit rollover/failures, currency, connector scope, data/model terms, source license and self-hosting remain unverified.

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.
